findings.title: before_validation crashes on blank host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the before_validation block calls self.host.sub! unconditionally. If host is nil or blank (e.g. admin submits empty host), this raises NoMethodError instead of failing validation. The record can never report a clean validation error and the request 500s.

findings.title: update/destroy 500 on missing id instead of 404
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb update does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then save_host(host) without checking for nil, and destroy calls host.destroy without checking. A bad/stale id causes NoMethodError on nil (undefined method `host=' or `destroy') resulting in a 500 instead of a 404 / not-found error.

findings.title: case-insensitive host lookup not lowercased
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb record_for_host does where("lower(host) = ?", host) where host is uri.host verbatim. If either the stored value or the lookup URL contains uppercase, lower(host) = 'EVILtrout.COM' never matches. The query must downcase the parameter (host.downcase) to actually be case-insensitive, otherwise host_allowed? incorrectly rejects valid referers.

findings.title: SQL injection via string-interpolated host in migration
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the data migration builds INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...) by interpolating the old site_setting value directly. A host containing a quote breaks out of the literal and allows SQL injection / migration failure. It must use quoting/parameterization or sanitize.

findings.title: migration assumes rows exist and crashes on fresh DB
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb category_id is derived via execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i without checking for empty results. On a fresh install or DB without embed_category / uncategorized_category_id rows, [0] is nil and the migration raises NoMethodError and cannot migrate. The same applies to the uncategorized fallback lookup.

findings.title: _hydrateEmbedded assumes plural ids are always arrays
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 _hydrateEmbedded now handles xxx_ids by calling obj[k].map directly. If the payload has null, undefined, or a non-array for a plural id key, this throws TypeError and breaks hydration of the whole record. It also leaves undefined entries in the hydrated array when _lookupSubType misses, instead of filtering them.

findings.title: no uniqueness constraint on host allows duplicates
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb there is no validates_uniqueness_of :host (case-insensitive) and db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb creates the table without a unique index. Duplicate hosts can be created via the admin UI, making record_for_host (.first) ambiguous and allowing inconsistent category mappings.
